misprints.printed: ὁ παραγέλλων καὶ αὐτὸς τὴν ἀρχήν
misprints.note: Single γ printed; the preceding ἀντιπαραγγέλλων has γγ.
Ending printed without the circumflex. Kept as printed.
Clearly printed this way, but it is an odd grammatical term for the middle voice and may be a misprint. Kept.

The breathing on αὑτοῦ is small. It looks rough, which also fits μεθ'.
Only a circumflex is visible, no smooth breathing. Earlier pages were mostly given οὖσα.
